## Применимость к проектам

Перенесены явные документальные оценки. Это частичный охват проектов, не проверенный integration seam и не измеренная польза.

- [AKUZ](../../projects/AKUZ.md): DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE; DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE / NEEDS_EVIDENCE. Pinned source implements code-graph retrieval, but only project-registry purpose and tech profile support this target as a potential navigation experiment; target source integration and actual costs not verified. Ограничения: Graph is static approximation, no T-SQL semantic parser verified, default telemetry and update egress require opt-out, global DSH/Hermes installers alter agent config, and real private source/credentials are forbidden in initial tests. Следующий тест: A existing grep/Read/LSP on frozen synthetic C#/TypeScript/Python cross-file question fixtures; B pinned CodeGraph source in isolated offline CLI without global install; C fake-home MCP/adapter only if owner permits; verify exact links/dynamic limits, p95 time, processed and resident tokens, SQLite disk/CPU/RSS/IO, watcher freshness and zero egress. [Основание](../../portfolio/2026-11-24/codegraph.md); предыдущая оценка: нет.
